incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: PD-INC-8921 triggered for service=redwood-model-catalog (high error rate). Paging oncall: @Maya Chen.
Maya Chen: acked the page, looking now. any immediate customer reports?
pagerduty: Incident acknowledged by Maya Chen (oncall). Escalation policy: SOC-Default.
Samir Patel: saw alerts too, 5xx spike from model-config service, lots of validation failures when loading model revisions.
Chris O'Neill: getting stack traces referencing tokenizer init: 'TokenizerError: unknown token mapping' — suspicious.
Maya Chen: running quick check: `rdctl model-config list --env prod --model-id turing-v3` shows active revision 84, recent deploy at 1768404600.
Devon K: 84 was a config-only change (tokenizer mapping tweak) but CI said ok. maybe bad mapping file shipped. pulling the artifact now.
Samir Patel: customer impact: CS reports 3 customers with garbled chat outputs and some 502s when model runtime throws on init. looks like config causes model worker crash loop -> 503 proxy.
Maya Chen: mitigation plan: 1) pin traffic away from problematic revision (route to rev 82). 2) rollback model-config revision 84. 3) scale up workers temporarily. executing step 1.
Maya Chen: `rdctl routing set --model turing-v3 --revision 82 --weight 100` -> submitted.
pagerduty: Note: routing change executed by Maya Chen at 1768404852.
Chris O'Neill: can we rollback the config artifact too? `rdctl model-config rollback --model turing-v3 --to-revision 82`
Devon K: running rollback now, watching logs. tail: `model-config-loader: loading mappings... error at line 12: unexpected token` — looks like a corrupted JSON in tokenizer mapping.
Samir Patel: rolling forward patch will take longer. for now routing to 82 should stop new failures. increasing autoscale just in case.
Maya Chen: autoscale bumped (temp) to 60 -> 120 to soak in-flight requests.
Priya Rao: notifying CS + sent customer-facing status note to affected accounts. shared mitigation steps and ETA for full fix.
Chris O'Neill: dev note: seems config generator introduced trailing commas for some mapping files when non-ascii characters present -> parser fails. will add stricter CI lint.
Maya Chen: confirm with metrics: error rate dropped ~85% after routing change, 502s down. some backlog still draining.
pagerduty: Escalation: if not resolved in 15m escalate to SRE lead.
Samir Patel: preparing post-incident scrub checklist and assigning owners: Devon will produce patch + CI rule, Chris will add parsing tolerance and tests, Maya to coordinate rollback validation and customer comms.
Maya Chen: handing off to Samir for the next 2h shift, I'll update runbook and go offline for lunch. Samir, you're lead now. :handshake:
Samir Patel: on it. will monitor for 30m then move to complete the rollback patch.
Devon K: pushed hotfix branch, running canary with mapping validator. snippet: ```json
{"validator": "strict-json", "allow_trailing_commas": false}```
Chris O'Neill: CI green on canary mapping, will request deploy to prod patch 1768405120.
Maya Chen: thanks team. once patch deploys, we should reintroduce rev 84 only if validator passes and we have staging-validated mappings.
Priya Rao: CS informed customers that mitigations are in place; will provide follow-up postmortem draft.
incident-bot: Incident PD-INC-8921 moved to status=mitigated by Maya Chen at 1768405260.
Maya Chen: marking thread to keep notes for postmortem. final action items: Devon create PR with lint + validator, Chris add parser tests + deploy patch, Samir validate and close.
Samir Patel: closing monitoring loop. will update Slack when all looks stable.
Maya Chen: thanks all. :thumbsup:
